all_original_mentioned_paragraphs.original_paragraph:
Orthogonality makes the cross expectation between $e_n+hu_n+r_n$ and $M_{n+1}+Q_{n+1}$ zero. To bound the remaining cross term, put $a=|M_{n+1}|$ and $b=|Q_{n+1}|$; nonnegativity of $\mathbb E(a-\lambda b)^2$ for every real $\lambda$ implies $\mathbb E[ab]\le(\mathbb Ea^2)^{1/2}(\mathbb Eb^2)^{1/2}$. Hence
